source_refs.note: Topic 1.10 Wi-Fi Security and Router Configuration as printed up to its first sub-heading (PDF 17, printed 12); the sub-headings are their own lessons.

blocks.text: Wi-Fi security protects the network from unauthorized access. Without security, anyone can use the internet. Hackers can steal personal information from unsecured networks. Secure Wi-Fi keeps data safe and private. It also prevents slow internet speed. Strong security improves overall network performance.
